source: Proposal appendix example 1 (also the walkthrough in 'What we will build')

criteria: Three plans with clearly different themes (e.g. temples and history, food and nightlife, day trips)
Each plan includes a flight, a hotel, a day-by-day schedule and a cost breakdown
Each plan total is at or under $5,000 and does not underestimate real costs
Every price has a source link and a fetch time
After the user edits (remove an item, add a day trip, move an item between days) and redrafts, the edits are kept and anything dropped to stay under budget is listed
